trigger.procedure: Session Establishment / Modification (session lookup by F-SEID)
trigger.message: PFCP message carrying a structurally-valid F-SEID IE whose flag byte is V4=0 AND V6=0 (an illegal flag combination per spec: 'at least one of V4, V6 shall be set')
trigger.field: F-SEID flag byte = 0x00 — semantically invalid value (spec requires V4|V6). open5gs uses the flags directly as a control-flow selector inside ogs_pfcp_f_seid_to_ip (which then returns OGS_ERROR), and the caller asserts on the OK return instead of range-checking the flag combination. PB1 'Invalid Value' (conflicting flag combination — exact term from the pattern definition).
trigger.precondition: PFCP association established (association_setup is sent first in the PoC)
